common.leave_prompt: Didn't ask for this, or changed your mind?

verify.subject: Confirm your email for Nowry
before: Confirm that this address is yours and your Nowry account is complete.
after: If you didn't create a Nowry account, ignore this email. Nothing happens unless the link is opened.
verify.footer: Sent to $email because this address was used to sign up for Nowry.

reset.subject: Reset your Nowry password
before: Someone asked to reset the password for the Nowry account with this address. If it was you, choose a new one here:
after: The link works once and for a short time. If you didn't ask, ignore this email: your password stays as it is.
reset.footer: Sent to $email because a password reset was requested for this address.

google.subject: Your Nowry account signs in with Google
before: Someone asked to reset the password for the Nowry account with this address. This account signs in with Google, not a password, so there is nothing to reset. Use Sign in with Google on the sign-in page:
after: If you didn't ask, ignore this email. Nothing has changed.
google.footer: Sent to $email because a password reset was requested for this address.

confirm.subject: You're on the Nowry waitlist
before: You asked for early access to Nowry. You're on the list.
Nowry turns what you read into flashcards and schedules every review, on the web and on Android. It is free during the beta.
We invite people in small groups. You will get one more email from us, with a link of your own, when your place opens.
confirm.footer: Sent to $email because this address was added to the Nowry waitlist.

account.subject: You already have a Nowry account
before: This address was just entered on the Nowry waitlist, but it already has a Nowry account. There is no need to wait: sign in here.
after: If you signed up with Google, there is no password: use Sign in with Google.
If this wasn't you, ignore this email. Nothing has changed.
account.footer: Sent to $email because this address was entered on the Nowry waitlist.
